justification: The assessment explicitly identifies the ground-truth defect: coefficient agreement does not imply χ(n) ≥ 0. In the supplied witness, coefficients agree through n=6 and differ at n=7, so X=6, yet χ(2)=χ(3)=−1; agreement holds because those coefficients vanish. This also invalidates the assessment’s cited justification for signed termwise majorization.
